entry.title: Shhhhh 1.0.4
entry.summary: Learn-the-noise spectral de-noiser (RX style): Learn, Threshold, Reduction, 6 nodes, Pass, Diff **For:** second-generation MPCs (MPC Live III, One G2, Key G2, XL) on MPC OS 3.10.1 or later. **Tested on:** MPC Live III, MPC OS 3.10.1. **Install:** from the Open MPC catalog or the Plugin Manager, or by hand: unzip, copy the folder inside `portable/` into `VST2 Plugins` at the root of a drive, turn on Preferences > Enhancements > External Plugin Support and restart the MPC. `Shhhhh-1.0.4-mpc-aarch6
